docs.summary: The searchable, drill-down menu popover used by Add Component and the material inspector's shader picker. Callers own the open/closed flag and the entry list; this draws the chrome, the search field, the folder navigation and the rows.
Matches Origami's DropdownBuilder default popover cap (Widgets/Dropdown.cs) so these popovers scroll the same way any other dropdown in the editor does.
